rule.name: AtomicGetThenSet
rule.message: This atomic field is read with get() and then written with set() in two steps: x.set(f(x.get())), or a check of !flag.get() whose block calls flag.set(true). Each call is atomic, the pair is not, so another thread can write between them: an update is lost, or two threads both pass the check and both run the block. Use one atomic call: incrementAndGet, addAndGet, updateAndGet(v -> f(v)) or accumulateAndGet for an update, and a check of flag.compareAndSet(false, true) for a check then act. An exception fits a field that only one thread writes.
